title: Fix black screen on app open by correcting router redirect logic

requirements.text: Fix the black-screen-on-open issue by removing all imperative navigation calls from the AppContent render path in frontend/src/App.tsx and ensuring the app always renders a visible UI state (RouterProvider or a loading/auth screen) while auth/profile state is being resolved.

quotes: When i open the draft it is just a black screen

A completely black screen usually means the app is rendering *nothing* because the router keeps redirecting during render. This happens when `router.navigate()` is called inside the component return path.

acceptanceCriteria: Opening the draft app no longer results in a black screen on first load.
frontend/src/App.tsx no longer calls router.navigate(...) during render (i.e., not inside conditional returns that return null).
When unauthenticated, the app renders a Login screen (or a loading screen while auth initializes) without rendering a blank page.
When authenticated but missing a user profile, the app routes to /onboarding without any render-loop/blank-screen behavior.
When authenticated and onboarding is complete, navigating to /onboarding redirects back to / without a blank screen.

requirements.text: Implement route-level guarding/redirect behavior using TanStack Router mechanisms (e.g., route beforeLoad/loader redirection or equivalent) so that authentication and onboarding redirects happen within the router lifecycle rather than from AppContent render logic.

quotes:
The simplest fix is:
- Don’t navigate inside the render flow.
- Instead, show nothing until routing state is consistent.

acceptanceCriteria: Redirect decisions for auth/onboarding are executed via TanStack Router route lifecycle (not via direct router.navigate calls inside AppContent render).
Directly entering the following URLs behaves correctly without blank screens: /login, /onboarding, /, /exercises, /plans (subject to auth/onboarding state).

requirements.text: Add a safe fallback UI for unexpected routing/auth errors so the app never displays an empty screen; the fallback must be visually consistent with the existing EVRVEST dark theme and use clear English user-facing text.

quotes: When i open the draft it is just a black screen

acceptanceCriteria: If an unexpected error occurs during initial auth/profile/routing resolution, the user sees a readable error state (not a blank screen).
The fallback provides at minimum: a short error message in English and a way to retry (e.g., reload button) without requiring developer tools.

constraints: Do not edit any files under frontend/src/components/ui (read-only shadcn components); compose them instead if needed.
Do not modify immutable frontend hook files: frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts, frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.tsx, frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, frontend/src/main.tsx.
Backend must remain single-actor; no backend schema changes are required for this routing fix.
nonGoals: Adding new product features beyond fixing routing/redirect behavior and preventing blank screens.
Changing the authentication provider (Internet Identity remains the only auth method).
Implementing new backend endpoints or changing persistence models.
